arxiv-2102-11350.title: A theory of Automated Market Makers in DeFi
arxiv-2102-11350.creator: Massimo Bartoletti ORCID:0000-0003-3796-9774, James Hsin-yu Chiang ORCID:0000-0002-5126-9494, Alberto Lluch-Lafuente ORCID:0000-0001-7405-0818
arxiv-2102-11350.description: Abstract . Automated market makers (AMMs) are one of the most prominent decentralized finance (DeFi) applications. AMMs allow users to trade different types of crypto-tokens, without the need to find a counter-party. There are several implementations and models for AMMs, featuring a variety of sophisticated economic mechanisms. We present a theory of AMMs.

arxiv-2104-09490.title: Oracle-based economic predictive control Journal: Computers & Chemical Engineering
arxiv-2104-09490.creator: José María Manzano, David Muñoz de la Peña 2, Daniel Limon 2
arxiv-2104-09490.description: Abstract This paper presents an economic model predictive controller, under the assumption that the only measurable signal of the plant is the economic cost to be minimized. In order to forecast the evolution of this economic cost for a given input trajectory, a prediction model with a NARX structure, the so-called oracle , is proposed.

arxiv-2107-05750.title: Which Molecular Cloud Structures Are Bound? astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , GILDAS ( Pety 2005 ; Gildas Team 2013 )
arxiv-2107-05750.creator: Neal J. Evans II, Mark Heyer, Marc-Antoine Miville-Deschênes, Quang Nguyen-Luong, Manuel Merello
arxiv-2107-05750.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Neal J. Evans II, Mark Heyer, Marc-Antoine Miville-Deschênes, Quang Nguyen-Luong, Manuel Merello. We analyze surveys of molecular cloud structures defined by tracers ranging from CO J = 1 → 0 J=1\rightarrow 0 through 13 CO J = 1 → 0 J=1\rightarrow 0 to dust emission together with NH 3 data. The mean value of the virial parameter and the fraction of mass in bound structures depends on the method used to identify structures.

arxiv-2111-00662.title: An Index Formula For Cauchy-Riemann Operators on Surfaces with boundary punctures
arxiv-2111-00662.creator: Dylan Cant
arxiv-2111-00662.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Dylan Cant. We give a self-contained proof of a formula computing the Fredholm index for asymptotically non-degenerate Cauchy-Riemann operators on surfaces with boundary punctures using the method of large anti-linear deformations. This method for computing the index was introduced in the case of closed surfaces by [ Tau96 ] and generalized to the case with interior punctures by [ Ger18 ] , as explained in [ Wen20 ] .

arxiv-2211-11498.title: Kaon-meson condensation and Δ \Delta resonance in hyperonic stellar matter within a relativistic mean-field model
arxiv-2211-11498.creator: Fu Ma 1 , Chen Wu 2 and Wenjun Guo 1
arxiv-2211-11498.description: Abstract We study the equation of state of dense baryon matter within the relativistic mean-field model, and we include Δ {\Delta} (1232) isobars into IUFSU model with hyperons and consider the possibility of kaon meson condensation. We find that it is necessary to consider the Δ \Delta resonance state inside the massive neutron star.

arxiv-2309-08160.title: Cross-Modal Synthesis of Structural MRI and Functional Connectivity Networks via Conditional ViT-GANs
arxiv-2309-08160.creator: Yuda Bi, Anees Abrol, Jing Sui, Vince Calhoun
arxiv-2309-08160.description: Abstract The cross-modal synthesis between structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI) and functional network connectivity (FNC) is a relatively unexplored area in medical imaging, especially with respect to schizophrenia. This study employs conditional Vision Transformer Generative Adversarial Networks (cViT-GANs) to generate FNC data based on sMRI inputs.

arxiv-2309-09152.title: Quantifying quantum coherence via Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobability
arxiv-2309-09152.creator: Agung Budiyono, Hermawan K. Dipojono
arxiv-2309-09152.description: Abstract Kirkwood-Dirac (KD) quasiprobability is a quantum analog of phase space probability of classical statistical mechanics, allowing negative or/and nonreal values. It gives an informationally complete representation of a quantum state. Recent works have revealed the important roles played by the KD quasiprobability in the broad fields of quantum science and quantum technology.

arxiv-2409-01119.title: Bounds for Joint Detection and Decoding on the Binary-Input AWGN Channel Thanks: This work is supported by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) within the project Open6GHub (grant no. 16KISK019).
arxiv-2409-01119.creator: Simon Obermüller, Jannis Clausius, Marvin Rübenacke, and Stephan ten Brink
arxiv-2409-01119.description: Abstract For asynchronous transmission of short blocks, preambles for packet detection contribute a non-negligible overhead. To reduce the required preamble length, JDD ( JDD ) techniques have been proposed that additionally utilize the payload part of the packet for detection. In this paper, we analyze two instances of JDD , namely HyPED ( HyPED ) and DAD ( DAD ).

arxiv-2412-17646.title: Rate of Model Collapse in Recursive Training
arxiv-2412-17646.creator: Ananda Theertha Suresh, Andrew Thangaraj, Aditya Nanda Kishore Khandavally
arxiv-2412-17646.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ananda Theertha Suresh, Andrew Thangaraj, Aditya Nanda Kishore Khandavally. Given the ease of creating synthetic data from machine learning models, new models can be potentially trained on synthetic data generated by previous models. This recursive training process raises concerns about the long-term impact on model quality. As models are recursively trained on generated data from previous rounds, their ability to capture the nuances of the original human-generated data may degrade. This is often referred to as model collapse .

arxiv-2501-02797.title: An a-posteriori analysis of co-kurtosis PCA based dimensionality reduction using a neural ODE solver
arxiv-2501-02797.creator: Tadikonda Shiva Sai, Hemanth Kolla, Konduri Aditya
arxiv-2501-02797.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tadikonda Shiva Sai, Hemanth Kolla, Konduri Aditya. A low-dimensional representation of thermochemical scalars based on cokurtosis principal component analysis (CoK-PCA) has been shown to effectively capture stiff chemical dynamics in reacting flows relative to the widely used principal component analysis (PCA). The effectiveness of the reduced manifold was evaluated in a priori analyses using both linear and nonlinear reconstructions of thermochemical scalars from aggressively truncated principal components (PCs). In this study, we demonstrate the efficacy of a CoK-PCA-based reduced manifold using a posteriori analysis.

arxiv-2508-09335.title: Instrument-limited pixel-level SNR bounds from optical throughput Note: Author’s preprint. A peer-reviewed version of this article was published in Optics Communications 608 (2026), Article 133016. Version of Record: DOI: 10.1016/j.optcom.2026.133016 .
arxiv-2508-09335.creator: Jan Sova, Marie Kolaříková
arxiv-2508-09335.description: Abstract The radiometric integral is the fundamental radiance–to–flux relation in imaging, whereas étendue is typically used as a compact system-level descriptor. For quantitative imaging and calibration, however, the operative mapping must be explicit at the level of individual detector pixels, including pixel acceptance and field-dependent pupil visibility.

arxiv-2510-10745.title: Fluidity and morphological stability of an amorphous thin film with radiation-induced defect kinetics
arxiv-2510-10745.creator: Tyler P. Evans, Eden Heyen
arxiv-2510-10745.description: Abstract It is common to model ion-irradiated amorphous thin films as if they were highly viscous fluids. In such models, one is frequently concerned with the ion-enhanced fluidity , a measure of the ability of the free interface to relax surface energy.

arxiv-2512-05903.title: Computer simulations of the Stark effect in the helium- β \beta complex of krypton in ICF conditions
arxiv-2512-05903.creator: G. Pérez-Callejo, E. Stambulchik, R. Florido, M. A. Gigosos
arxiv-2512-05903.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by G. Pérez-Callejo, E. Stambulchik, R. Florido, M. A. Gigosos. There is an ongoing interest in using spectroscopy in inertial confinement fusion (ICF) experiments, where dopants such as krypton can provide vital information about the temperature and density of the imploding plasma. While the most advanced tools for calculating Stark profiles are computer simulation models (CSMs), their application to complex lineshapes under the extreme conditions of ICF experiments is computationally challenging.

pmc-10680069.title: Effect of local anesthetics on renal function: An animal study in Iran
pmc-10680069.creator: Rasul Gheisari, Masoud Saatchi, Firoozeh Estakhri, Mehrdad Vossoughi, Mohammad Bazaei, Zahra Khosravani
pmc-10680069.description: Background:Although most of the metabolism of local anesthetics (LAs) takes place in the liver, no study has investigated the effect of these anesthetics on the kidney function of single-kidney humans or animals. The present study was conducted to examine the effect of LAs on renal function in single-kidney rats.

pmc-10720125.title: Plasmodium knowlesi in pig-tailed macaques: a potential new model for malaria vaccine research
pmc-10720125.creator: Melanie J Shears, Rebekah A Reynolds, Caroline J Duncombe, Felicia N Watson, Weston J Staubus, Chris Chavtur, Annette M Seilie, Tuan M Tran, Sumana Chakravarty, Stephen L Hoffman, Sean C Murphy
pmc-10720125.description: BackgroundPlasmodium knowlesi is an established experimental model for basic and pre-clinical malaria vaccine research. Historically, rhesus macaques have been the most common host for malaria vaccine studies with P. knowlesi parasites. However, rhesus are not natural hosts for P. knowlesi, and there is interest in identifying alternative hosts for vaccine research.

pmc-11431291.title: A Review and Meta-Analysis of Genotype by Environment Interaction in Commercial Shrimp Breeding
pmc-11431291.creator: Md. Mehedi Hasan, Peter C. Thomson, Herman W. Raadsma, Mehar S. Khatkar
pmc-11431291.description: (1) Background: Genotype-by-environment interaction (G×E) can adversely impact genetic improvement programs. The presence of G×E is mainly measured as the genetic correlation between the same trait measured in different environments where departure from unity can be taken as presence of G×E.

pmc-11471303.title: Optimised Protocol for Managing Failed Catheterisation: Leveraging Bedside Retrograde Urethrography and Cystourethroscopy
pmc-11471303.creator: Basavesh S Patil, Siddanagouda B Patil, Vinay S Kundargi, Santosh R Patil, Manoj K Vaidya, Vikas Shukla
pmc-11471303.description: IntroductionUrethral catheterization is a routine procedure often required for many hospitalized patients. Various conditions, such as meatal stenosis, stricture urethra, false passage, benign prostatic hyperplasia, bladder neck contractures, and impacted urethral stones, can contribute to difficulty in catheterisation. In the setting of failed attempts at per urethral catheter placement, the subsequent intervention is suprapubic catheter (SPC) insertion.

pmc-11499929.title: Large language model use in clinical oncology
pmc-11499929.creator: Nicolas Carl, Franziska Schramm, Sarah Haggenmüller, Jakob Nikolas Kather, Martin J. Hetz, Christoph Wies, Maurice Stephan Michel, Frederik Wessels, Titus J. Brinker
pmc-11499929.description: Large language models (LLMs) are undergoing intensive research for various healthcare domains. This systematic review and meta-analysis assesses current applications, methodologies, and the performance of LLMs in clinical oncology. A mixed-methods approach was used to extract, summarize, and compare methodological approaches and outcomes. This review includes 34 studies.

pmc-11651912.title: Gastric remnant volvulus following gastric sleeve conversion to Roux-en-Y gastric bypass: a case report
pmc-11651912.creator: Caroline E. Roberts, Meghan R. Mansour, Emmanuel M. Nageeb, Kevin R. Krause
pmc-11651912.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Gastric remnant volvulus following Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) surgery is rare, with only two previously reported cases. Herein, we present the first case of gastric remnant volvulus following gastric sleeve conversion to RYGB in a 32-year-old female. Management for gastric remnant volvulus has not been clearly described in the literature due to the rarity of cases; however, previously documented cases of gastric remnant volvulus following RYGB were managed with gastropexy or resection of the gastric remnant.

pmc-11690685.title: CHOICES AND EXPECTATIONS OF END-OF-LIFE HEALTH CARE PROXY: A COMPARATIVE STUDY BETWEEN TAIWAN AND THE UNITED STATES

It compared 345 Taiwanese and 339 Californian respondents, matched by gender and age. ResultsDespite similar demographics, distinct preferences emerged. A majority (75.

pmc-12606924.title: High prevalence and multifactorial risks of sarcopenia in knee osteoarthritis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12606924.creator: Tian-Xin Chen, Tong-Jie Yang, Sheng Cheng, Zhi-Long Zhang, Tao Liu
pmc-12606924.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the prevalence and risk factors of sarcopenia in patients with knee osteoarthritis (KOA) through a systematic review and meta-analysis.MethodsA comprehensive search was conducted in PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, China National Knowledge Infrastructure, and WanFang databases for studies published between January 2000 and June 2025.

pmc-12961975.title: Clemastine Restores Myelination Protein Expression in S16 Schwann Cells by Enhancing AMPK Activation and Reducing H2O2-Induced Oxidative Stress
pmc-12961975.creator: Chawon Yun, So Young Lee, Jun Hong Won, Ga Hee Kim, Tae Hyun Kim, Jung Il Lee
pmc-12961975.description: Peripheral nerve injury and oxidative stress can severely impair Schwann cell function by disrupting the expression of key myelin proteins, promoting intracellular lipid accumulation, and damaging mitochondrial integrity. These pathological changes are central to various neurodegenerative disorders and chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy, yet effective therapeutic approaches remain limited.

pmc-13325789.title: Lifestyle front offices in dutch hospitals: a cross-sectional survey on similarities, differences and future needs
pmc-13325789.creator: Florien Ham, Mariëtte R Boon, Janke F de Groot, Meike J van Boxtel, Ghislaine A P G van Mastrigt, Judith G M Jelsma, Elisabeth F C van Rossum
pmc-13325789.description: BackgroundSince 2019, Dutch hospitals have been developing approaches aiming to bridge the gap between hospital care and community-based lifestyle support. This has led to the introduction of the so called ‘Lifestyle Front Office” (LFO) in 2022. The LFO enables healthcare professionals to refer patients for lifestyle and (psycho)social support adjacent to medical treatment in the context of specialist medical care.

pmc-13583109.title: Volatile Additives Engineering: A Trustworthy Morphology Control Strategy in Non‐Fullerene Organic Solar Cells
pmc-13583109.creator: Jianqiang Qin, Zhiqin Lai, Jiang‐Ling Shi, Zheng Xiao, Yuwei Duan, Zhiping Hu, Juan Du, Qiang Peng
pmc-13583109.description: Over the past few years, the efficiency of organic solar cells (OSCs) has significantly increased from about 15% to 21%. The morphology of the photoactive layer plays a critical role in performance improvement of OSCs. Therefore, numerous methods have been developed to optimize the morphology of the photoactive layer and unlock the full potential of the devices.

pmc-13641933.title: Complementary PET and MRI of myeloperoxidase activity as a noninvasive surrogate for tissue acrolein in experimental neuroinflammation
pmc-13641933.creator: Enrico Küllenberg, Siyuan Sun, Cuihua Wang, Negin Jalali Motlagh, Mariane Le Fur, Gregory R. Wojtkiewicz, Seth A. Herr, Riyi Shi, John W. Chen
pmc-13641933.description: Background:Myeloperoxidase (MPO), a pro-inflammatory enzyme, and acrolein, a reactive aldehyde present in the environment and produced in the body, play pivotal roles in experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) and multiple sclerosis (MS). However, the relationship between MPO activity and acrolein levels is not well understood.
